label: The token ' of' when no word before it asks for it: right after is/are/was/were ('is of great importance', 'was of modest size'), after 'and' or a comma in 'of course', or 'Of' opening a sentence or title ('Of all the...'); also the ' of' piece split off Spanish 'ofertas/ofertando'. Quiet when the word before governs it: noun of noun ('cup of coffee', 'history of'), 'afraid of', 'out of', 'kind of', 'because of', 'one of / all of'; verbs taking 'of' ('spoke of', 'made of') are only weak; whole-token 'offer', 'officer', 'off' stay silent.
